from work import evaluate
p={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':7,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':False,'environment':True}
cases=[
('late_layer',{'layers':[{'i':'bad'},{'i':0}]},p,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':0,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('env_repairs',{'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'-0'}},p,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':0,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('null_then_env',{'layers':[{'i':None}],'environment':{'i':'+12'}},p,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':12,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('disabled_nonempty',{'environment':{'i':'1'}},{**p,'environment':False},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('unknown_layer',{'layers':[{'z':1}]},p,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
('empty_env',{'environment':{}},{**p,'environment':False},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':7,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('unicode_decimal',{'environment':{'i':'١٢'}},p,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
]
for name,req,policy,expected in cases:
 actual=evaluate(req,policy)
 assert actual==expected,(name,actual,expected)
print('7 independent precedence/boundary cases passed')
